summary: Mr. Arking explains the custom of pouring sixteen drops of wine during the reading of the ten plagues in the Haggadah. He discusses the different methods of pouring or flicking the wine and the reasons provided by the Mekubalim for this practice.
questions: Why do we pour sixteen drops of wine during the Haggadah?
What is the difference between the Ashkenazic and Middle Eastern ways of removing the wine?
What does the wine represent when we pour it out?
Who are the Mekubalim that influenced this custom?
